summary.text: Tiffany Byrne is the Democratic candidate for Arizona House of Representatives District 25 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the July 21, 2026 Democratic primary.
A former classroom teacher and education administrator, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she would focus on education, families and affordability.

paragraphs.text: Byrne earned a bachelor's degree from San Diego State University, a master's degree in curriculum and instruction from Chapman University and a master's degree in organizational leadership from Northern Arizona University.

Ballotpedia says her professional experience includes work as a science curriculum specialist and high school chemistry teacher in the Dysart Unified School District, and service on committees at the Arizona Department of Education.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has lived in Arizona for more than 30 years and spent more than 20 years as a classroom teacher before moving into educational leadership.
